title: DtMF World Tour Stages for Lisbon — Adidas Flamboyan 'Vivid Red' Wide Release 5 Days Out as Madrid 10-Night Residency Looms
detail: Following the triumphant two-night Barcelona run at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys (May 22–23, 54,000 per night sold out), Bad Bunny moved toward Lisbon on May 25 ahead of his May 26–27 dates at Estádio da Luz — one of Europe's largest stadiums (capacity ~65,000). The Lisbon shows mark the second stop of the European stadium leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour, which continues into a landmark 10-night residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid beginning May 30, making Bad Bunny one of the very few artists ever to play a double-digit run at a European football stadium. May 30 also marks the wide release date of the Adidas x Bad Bunny Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (KI7916) in Vivid Red — inspired by Puerto Rico's flamboyan tree — at $120 via the Adidas Confirmed app, following the shoe's preview within the Zara 'BENITO ANTONIO' collection imagery. The convergence of the Madrid residency opening and the Flamboyan launch on the same date was deliberate, with sneaker and fashion media (SneakerNews, WWD, Sneaker Bar Detroit, Sole Retriever) building coverage throughout the week. 'DtMF' continues to hold 60 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs — the all-time chart record — with no sign of chart slippage despite the European shift.
